```
rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

Inline comments:
In `@services/pricing_sync.py`:
- Around line 14-16: Remove BILLING_API_KEY from the logger.info call in the
pricing sync flow, logging only the tenant identifier and sync status. Eliminate
the hard-coded credential from pricing_sync.py, rotate the exposed key, and load
the replacement through the project’s secret-managed configuration mechanism.

In `@services/reorder_report.py`:
- Line 11: Update build_report to use None as the seen default, then initialize
a new list inside the function when seen is not provided, while preserving any
caller-supplied list.

In `@src/inventory.ts`:
- Around line 28-29: Update checkReorder to treat stock equal to
product.reorderThreshold as requiring reorder by changing the strict comparison
to an inclusive boundary, while preserving the existing behavior for stock below
and above the threshold.
- Around line 14-19: Update getProduct to require both productId and tenantId
when searching products, matching p.id and p.tenantId in the find predicate
before returning the product; preserve the existing not-found error behavior.

In `@src/orders.ts`:
- Around line 10-14: Update the order validation around the items loop to reject
non-integer or non-positive quantities, aggregate quantities by product ID so
duplicate lines are combined, and compare each aggregate against
availableStock(product) rather than product.stock. Perform these validations
before calling reserveStock, preserving the existing insufficient_stock error
behavior.
- Around line 39-41: Update describeDiscount to safely handle orders whose
optional discountCode is absent, returning the established defined no-discount
description instead of calling trim on undefined; preserve the existing trim and
uppercase behavior when a code is present, or explicitly change the function’s
return type only if absence is represented by an allowed value.

In `@src/pricing.ts`:
- Around line 29-40: Update the pricing calculation around subtotalDollars and
totalDollars to keep all monetary values in integer cents: accumulate each line
as unitPrice * quantity without dividing by 100, then apply the selected
business rounding rule once to the discounted cent total. Preserve the breakdown
fields and ensure subtotal and total remain cent values.

In `@web/InventoryDashboard.tsx`:
- Line 21: Guard the products display in InventoryDashboard so the initial empty
products array does not access products[0].name. Render the “Top variety” text
only when a first product exists, while preserving the current product-name
output once fetchProducts populates the list.
- Line 33: Update the table cell rendering in the product row to render
product.name as normal text instead of using dangerouslySetInnerHTML, while
preserving the existing displayed value.

In `@web/OrderForm.tsx`:
- Around line 14-17: Update addLine so adding a line does not mutate the
existing items state array; create and pass a new array containing the current
items and the new line to setItems, preserving the existing item values and
new-line defaults.
- Line 20: Update the form submit handler in OrderForm to receive the submit
event, call preventDefault(), and then invoke props.onSubmit with items and
discountCode so the browser does not perform a native submission.
```
